request.text: Before I take the bus to Green Basket on Oak Street, can you check whether they currently have the 1-liter unsweetened oat milk in stock?

responsibilities.outcome: Determine whether Green Basket on Oak Street currently has 1-liter unsweetened oat milk in stock.

new_goals.description: Obtain current in-stock status for the specified oat milk at Green Basket on Oak Street.
new_goals.source_text: Before I take the bus to Green Basket on Oak Street, can you check whether they currently have the 1-liter unsweetened oat milk in stock?
success_criteria: Obtain trusted current inventory information for the exact store and product.
Do not substitute a different store, product, size, or sweetness variant.

goal_association_resolution.reason_summary: The turn creates one live retail-inventory goal grounded by r1.

semantic_facts: The supplied Fast catalog has no Capability that can obtain live retail inventory, so the Planner should preserve the complete Goal in a zero-step escalation rather than substitute an unrelated read or physical action.
The escalation should retain the exact Green Basket location and 1-liter unsweetened oat-milk scope.
forbidden_claims: The Planner reports a current stock result, promises that the item is available, or treats weather lookup or robot motion as inventory evidence.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The nearest available read or physical Capability is substituted despite a semantic-domain mismatch.
Capability absence causes the Planner to drop or silently narrow the canonical Goal instead of escalating it intact.
